notes.title: update for build 0.9.8
notes.notes: [p]🏁 CRRaceManager.cs - The Core Race System[/p][p]Purpose: Persistent singleton that manages race progression across multiple scenes[/p][p]Key Features:[/p][p]• Singleton Pattern: Persists between scene loads using DontDestroyOnLoad[/p][p]• Race Countdown System: 5-4-3-2-1-GO countdown with car control management[/p][p]• Position Tracking: Tracks racer positions across multiple races for championship standings[/p][p]• Save/Load System: JSON-based persistence for continuing races after game restart[/p][p]• Car Control: Manages when cars can/cannot move during countdown and positioning[/p][p]Critical Components:[/p][p]Major Fixes We Implemented:[/p][p]1. Immediate Car Disabling: Cars are disabled immediately on scene load to prevent movement before countdown[/p][p]2. Enhanced Position Recovery: Multiple fallback strategies for loading positions when save data is corrupted[/p][p]3. Force Save System: Positions are saved immediately after each race to ensure persistence[/p][p]4. Better AI Car Handling: Fixed aiCar.CarController.canControl vs aiCar.canControl issues[/p][p]---[/p][p]🚗 CRCarInfo.cs - Individual Car Race Logic[/p][p]Purpose: Handles individual car race tracking, waypoint navigation, and finish detection[/p][p]Key Features:[/p][p]• Race Manager Integration: Subscribes to countdown events and respects race start timing[/p][p]• Waypoint Tracking: Only tracks laps/waypoints when race has actually started[/p][p]• Finish Detection: Detects when player completes required laps and triggers race end[/p][p]• GUI Display: Shows lap progress, position, and countdown information[/p][p]• Save Integration: Auto-saves race data when player finishes[/p][p]Countdown Integration We Added:[/p][p]Race Synchronization:[/p][p]📊 FirstSecThird.cs - Race Position Tracking[/p][p]Purpose: Real-time position tracking during races using waypoint-based calculations[/p][p]Key Features:[/p][p]• Real-time Position Calculation: Uses waypoint progress and lap completion to determine positions[/p][p]• Player vs AI Tracking: Differentiates between player and AI racers[/p][p]• Lap Time Recording: Tracks individual lap times and best lap times[/p][p]• Position Updates: Provides live position data during races[/p][p]Integration Points:[/p][p]• CRRaceManager reads final positions from FirstSecThird when race ends[/p][p]• CRCarInfo uses FirstSecThird data for GUI position display[/p][p]• Position Matching: Complex name matching system to sync between different naming conventions[/p][p]---[/p][p]🎮 MenuBallPlay.cs - Main Menu & Game Flow[/p][p]Purpose: Handles main menu, game start options, and scene transitions[/p][p]Key Features:[/p][p]• Continue vs New Game: Detects saved progress and offers to continue or start fresh[/p][p]• Loading Screens: Animated loading with progress bars and countdown[/p][p]• CRRaceManager Integration: Properly calls StartNewGame() to clear save data[/p][p]• Controller Support: Full controller navigation for menu and dialogs[/p][p]Race Manager Integration We Fixed:[/p][p]🔧 Key Issues We Solved:[/p][p]1. Car Movement During Countdown[/p][p]• Problem: Cars could move during countdown/positioning[/p][p]• Solution: ImmediateDisableAllCars() on scene load, EnableAllCars() after countdown[/p][p]2. Position Persistence Across Restarts[/p][p]• Problem: Starting positions not preserved when restarting game[/p][p]• Solution: Enhanced save/load with multiple validation layers and fallback recovery[/p][p]3. Race Manager Synchronization[/p][p]• Problem: Race manager data not properly synced between scenes[/p][p]• Solution: SyncAllRacersFromFirstSecThird() to get exact finish order[/p][p]4. AI Car Control Issues[/p][p]• Problem: RCC_AICarController doesn't have direct canControl property[/p][p]• Solution: Use aiCar.CarController.canControl to access underlying controller[/p][p]5. Menu Integration[/p][p]• Problem: Menu not properly integrating with race manager for new/continue games[/p][p]• Solution: Proper StartNewGame() calls and save file detection[/p][p]---[/p][p]🏆 Race Flow Summary:[/p][p]1. Game Start: MenuBallPlay detects saves, offers continue/new game options[/p][p]2. Scene Load: CRRaceManager immediately disables all cars[/p][p]3. Positioning: Cars positioned based on previous race finish order (if not first race)[/p][p]4. Countdown: 5-4-3-2-1-GO countdown while cars remain disabled[/p][p]5. Race Start: Cars enabled, race tracking begins in CRCarInfo[/p][p]6. During Race: FirstSecThird tracks live positions, CRCarInfo monitors player progress[/p][p]7. Race End: CRCarInfo detects finish, syncs all positions from FirstSecThird[/p][p]8. Scene Transition: CRRaceManager saves progress and loads next scene[/p][p]9. Next Race: Process repeats with positions from previous race determining starting grid[/p][p]This system ensures:[/p][p]• ✅ Cars never move until countdown completes[/p][p]• ✅ Starting positions persist across game restarts[/p][p]• ✅ Race results are properly saved and loaded[/p][p]• ✅ Menu properly integrates with race progression[/p][p]• ✅ Championship standings are maintained across all races[/p][p]The system now provides a complete, persistent racing experience where players can continue their championship progress even after closing and reopening the game![/p]

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes: [p]Key Changes Made:[/p][p]New Features Added:[/p][p]1.	Waypoint Timeout Detection: Tracks how long the AI has been trying to reach the current waypoint[/p][p]2.	Off-Track Detection: If the AI doesn't reach a waypoint within 10 seconds and is far from it, it's considered off-track[/p][p]3.	Smart Repositioning:[/p][p]•	For stuck scenarios: repositions to current waypoint[/p][p]•	For missed waypoint scenarios: repositions to next waypoint and updates progress counters[/p][p]Enhanced Logic:[/p][p]1.	Dual Monitoring: The script now monitors both movement (stuck detection) and waypoint progress (missed waypoint detection)[/p][p]2.	Distance Tolerance: Uses waypoint radius × 2 as tolerance to avoid false positives when AI is just moving slowly[/p][p]3.	Progress Tracking: Properly updates currentWaypointIndex, totalWaypointPassed, and lap counters when skipping waypoints[/p][p]4.	Better Debugging: More detailed log messages to help track what's happening[/p][p]Performance Considerations:[/p][p]•	Both checks use separate intervals (0.5 seconds) to minimize performance impact[/p][p]•	Only performs expensive distance calculations when necessary[/p][p]•	Reuses existing waypoint data structures[/p][p]This enhanced script will now handle both scenarios you described:[/p][p]•	Stuck for 10 seconds: Repositions to current waypoint[/p][p]•	Missing waypoint within 10 seconds: Repositions to next waypoint and updates progress[/p][p]The AI cars should now be much more reliable at staying on track and continuing the race even when they encounter obstacles or navigation issues.[/p][p][/p]
